english.title: Sex offenders fail to allow police to take fingerprints / photographs
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being subject to notification requirements under Section 2(1) of the Sex Offenders Act 1997, failed without reasonable excuse, to allow

(A)_[your fingerprints]_
(B)_[your photograph]_
(C)_[your fingerprints and photograph]_

to be taken by

(D)_[a police officer]_
(E)_[a person authorised for the purpose by the police officer in charge of the station]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 3(1B)(a) and 3(1A) of the Sex Offenders Act 1997.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE - now see H5862 and H5863

(i) See Section 1(1) for who qualifies as subject to notification requirements
(ii) As amended by Schedule 5 to the Criminal Justice and Court Services Act 2000
(iii) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
